title: SlowLoopReply
description: Findings in the candidate chunks of the project's sources that help the conversation now, and queries for the next search. Empty lists are a valid reply.

quote.description: Verbatim from the candidate's text, 3–25 words.

note.description: One line, up to 140 characters: «Подтверждает / Дополняет / Противоречит: …».

questionId.description: The open question it is about, if any.

queries.description: Up to 3 queries for the next search, each up to 8 words: terms and names from the conversation.
